nima: FYI we saw a jump in funcall parse errors on new raven-mini-int4 canary after the record-separator change. failures look like interleaved RS (0x1E) inside a single JSON object causing strict parsers to choke.

rosa: can you paste a sample?

nima: sample bytes: `{"action":"write","path":"/tmp/a"}
` — effectively double RS right after object end, but sometimes RS lands inside strings because of chunk boundaries, e.g. `"name": "foobar"` -> invalid JSON.

evan: observed this too. correlated with kernel chunking when tokenizer flush occurs mid-string. batch=1 streaming routes hit it most. non-streaming calls rare.

shreya: short-term: we can try tolerant NDJSON parse that splits on RS and rejects pieces that don't parse, then if a single piece fails run a byte-safety cleaner that removes RS inside unquoted regions only. tag telemetry `rescue=rs_tolerant_split`.

ken: i'm wary of cleaning inside strings because that changes user-visible content. prefer splitting first; if a piece still invalid, then route to mirror for manual triage rather than mutate. we can allow `rescue=strip_unquoted_rs` only for canary routes and only with explicit opt-in.

rosa: telemetry note: current canary shows 7.6% parse_fail_rate for raven-mini-int4 on seq<100. fp16 baseline 0.5%. uploaded 20 raw traces to s3://canary/rs/1715009999.

nima: canary-bot: deployed raven-mini-int4 @ 1715008000 -> 28 successes / 3 failures in last 15m. last cnry id=rs-1715009966.

evan: long-term: quant/kernel should avoid injecting RS into token bytes and instead emit RS as separate record bytes between chunks. filed QNT-601.

shreya: action items: 1) evan prototype NDJSON-split rescue (opt-in) and push PoC today 2) ken add monitor+alert if rescue>2% for 30m 3) nima run golden-funcall check on sanitized vs raw to measure drift.

ken: add guard: do not auto-rescue if cleaned payload length differs from original by >1% or if strings were modified (we can diff quoted regions).

nima: I'll run a 6h soft canary with rescue flag set on a small hostset and report back. ping me for s3 access. :white_check_mark:
